stage_meaning.10: dedicated audit and acceptance scope exist
stage_meaning.25: architecture or delivery contract is accepted
stage_meaning.40: core implementation exists with focused automated evidence
stage_meaning.55: the gate's canonical internal path is integrated end-to-end
stage_meaning.70: the gate's real user-facing or operational path is wired
stage_meaning.85: regression/E2E, exact-head CI, APK/device evidence applicable to the gate are complete
stage_meaning.100: the gate Definition of Done is complete, status/handoff is current, and no gate acceptance gap remains

gates.name: Unified Item + adapter/migration + regression
gates.note: Canonical read/write migration path is integrated and regression-tested, but Home still retains a legacy view boundary, so Gate A is not yet at user-facing completion.

gates.name: Notebook UI + persistence
gates.note: The product contract exists, but the complete Notebook editor/auto-save/read-only/edit/checklist user flow is not yet delivered.

gates.name: Home + Search on canonical Item path
gates.note: Real Home/Search, archive/trash and user-facing task flows are wired, but full gate-level E2E/device evidence and final migration cleanup remain incomplete.

gates.name: Calendar + Prayer Times + Iranian Holidays
gates.note: Calendar and official-holiday implementation evidence exists, while the verified prayer-times provider remains an active gap.

gates.name: Widget + Lock Screen validation
gates.note: A dedicated audit and product scope exist, but the shared native Widget foundation is not implemented on main.

gates.name: PDF + Print + IranSans
gates.note: No dedicated gate delivery evidence is credited yet.

gates.name: Reminder/Google Calendar + Backup/Dropbox
gates.note: Backup/Dropbox foundations and tests exist, but the whole Gate G contract including Reminder/Google Calendar and full portability validation is incomplete.

gates.name: E2E + device release + APK evidence
gates.note: Automated analyze/test/APK production exists, but complete real-device E2E coverage for all required product paths is not yet demonstrated.
